# ghost_organization (Data Source)

Reads an organization's public profile: its name, details, members and pinned repositories. Anyone can read a profile, but only members see the private members and their own role. Use `ghost_organization_teams` for its teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ghost_organization" "example" {
  slug = "my-org"
}

output "organization" {
  value = {
    name        = data.ghost_organization.example.name
    description = data.ghost_organization.example.description
    members     = [for m in data.ghost_organization.example.members : m.username]
    pinned      = [for r in data.ghost_organization.example.pinned_repositories : r.full_name]
    my_role     = data.ghost_organization.example.viewer_role
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug of the organization to look up. Ghost matches it case-insensitively. The token's user doesn't need to be a member.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the organization was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `description` (String) The organization's description, null when none is set.
- `email` (String) The organization's public contact email, null when none is set.
- `id` (String) The organization's slug as Ghost spells it (lower case).
- `location` (String) The organization's location, null when none is set.
- `logo` (String) The URL of the organization's logo, null when it has none.
- `members` (Attributes List) The organization's members, sorted by username. Members of the organization see every member; anyone else sees only the members who made their membership public. Roles aren't included. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) The organization's display name.
- `pinned_repositories` (Attributes List) The repositories pinned to the organization's profile, in pinned order. Only repositories the token's user can read are listed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pinned_repositories))
- `public_repository_count` (Number) How many public repositories the organization has. Private repositories aren't counted, even for members.
- `viewer_role` (String) The token user's role in the organization: `member`, `admin` or `owner`. Null when the user isn't a member, or holds only custom roles.
- `website` (String) The organization's website, null when none is set.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `image` (String) The member's avatar URL, null when they have none.
- `name` (String) The member's display name.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the member shows their membership outside the organization.
- `username` (String) The member's username.


<a id="nestedatt--pinned_repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pinned_repositories`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The repository's description, null when none is set.
- `full_name` (String) The repository's full name, `organization/slug`. Pass it to the `repository` argument of other resources.
- `name` (String) The repository's display name.
- `slug` (String) The repository's slug.
- `visibility` (String) Either `public` or `private`.
